title: Tank Arena rules, v1, and a balance retune
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: Tank Arena has real rules: fixed mirrored spawns, a two-minute limit, and 9-point builds that set each tank's damage, speed, reload and HP. Kiter beats Charger, Charger beats Sniper, and Sniper beats Kiter, 66–76% of the time each. The first numbers gave 7-second fights where slow armored builds won, so tanks now have 6.5× the HP, every stat grows about 20% per level, and Speed also shortens the reload. Matches last about 34 seconds, and no build wins more than 66% on average.
next: founder approval of the new numbers; Kiter vs Kiter still mostly draws.
